sourceMode: Fresh public HTTP for paid qualification; saved sources are offline controls only, never substituted into a live request.

qualification.complete: Every independently expected fact and requested association is present, with no independently detected conflicting records or URLs.
qualification.useful-partial: At least one requested source-supported record/reference survives, but some expected records, details or ordering are missing or other records are wrong.
qualification.unusable: An artifact executes, but no requested expected record/reference is supported. Empty data is unusable when independent evidence is nonempty.
qualification.unresolved: No artifact is published, or artifact execution fails to return data.
qualification.oracleFailure: Not a product classification. Stop qualification if independent evidence is unavailable or an oracle fails; preserve the failure rather than guessing truth.
qualification.unscorable: Evaluator measurement gap, not a product verdict or caller approval requirement. Return classification:null and scorable:false when record facts have no explicit request-derived role binding or actual keys have unknown/ambiguous meanings; never search an unlabeled value bag to award complete.
qualification.fieldRoles: Freeze evaluator-only fact.role and roles[role].keys from the original request and actual key meanings before comparing values. Caller headline/intro and amount/currency fields retain their exact roles. Generated schemas may explain key meanings but cannot supply truth or weaken the request. Expected values and associations come from independent actual source captures. Parent context is inherited only by explicit role declarations.
qualification.cardinality: Enforce one-per-target requirements with uniqueResults:true and explicit count ceilings with maximumCount. Report duplicate values separately; no silent deduplication. Link objects bind declared valueFields. Evaluator-declared metadataKeys preserve legitimate labels/metadata; remaining unknown object keys are unscorable. Stray scalars in result lists remain unmatched results.
qualification.falseAcceptance: A positive reviewer verdict accompanies independently unusable output, unexpected URLs or unmatched records. Missing-only acceptance is separately flagged for auditing the review reason, not automatically called false acceptance.
qualification.emptyResults: An independently verified genuinely empty source may return empty data successfully.
qualification.newsOrder: Independently collect the eligible main-article pool. Any up-to-ten distinct supported headline/link/description associations can qualify; do not impose universal editorial importance or fail a different valid ten merely because an oracle listed others first.
qualification.missingDescriptions: Null or absent is correct when the independently inspected source card has no published description. Missing a source-present description is partial, not grounds to discard supported headlines.
qualification.truthTiming: Freeze request, oracle rules and source-backed facts before model work. A changed fresh source requires its own independently recorded facts; never silently grade it against stale headlines/prices or against learned selectors.

additionalCases.instruction: get me the headlines, abstract/description, and article links for the top 10 articles from theguardian.com
additionalCases.oracle: Independent eligible main primary-card URL/headline/description pool, deduplicated by URL. Any ten supported distinct article records may meet the target.

additionalCases.instruction: get me the headlines, abstract/description, and article links for the top 10 articles from spiegel.de
additionalCases.oracle: Independent main article[data-sara-article-id] cards and current-news titled article links, including source-derived kicker/headline aliases and same-card descriptions. Any ten supported distinct article records may meet the target.

additionalCases.instruction: Give me the timetable of animafabrik.com.
additionalCases.oracle: All timed menu-item records, associated day/title/teacher-duration/level, including every source-present menu-item-option cancellation or substitution note.
The exact app 381210 base-game offer and its EUR current price; exclude bundles, DLC and unrelated offers. Preserve the original supplied schema.

measurements: Independent classification per discovery result and separate AI-free fresh execution
Actual dispatched provider requests, including unsuccessful requests and HTTP429 attempts
Provider/SDK input and output token totals with explicit unavailable-usage coverage
Observed waits following actual HTTP429 responses, without preemptive reservations
Discovery preparation, discovery, artifact preparation, execution and total wall time separately
Execution model calls must be zero; no manual corrections or hidden reruns
